title: HostCover Premiums: Charging per Stay, Superhost Discount and Refunds
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** paid levels charge a premium on each stay the plan covers, at the moment the stay's earnings are released.

**Rule.** The premium on a stay is the level's premium rate (a percentage) of the premium base (the stay's nightly subtotal and cleaning fee), raised to the level's lowest premium per stay when lower, then reduced by the level's Superhost premium discount (a percentage) when the host account's tier is Superhost on the stay's check-in date, and rounded half up to the cent. The minimum is applied before the discount. HostCover Essential charges nothing.

- A premium is charged only on a plan whose status is active.
- A premium is charged once per stay.
- When host-funded guest refunds later reduce the stay's premium base, the premium is refunded in the same proportion, never more than was charged.

## The premium as a sequence of quantities

1. Rate premium: the premium base multiplied by the premium rate, divided by 100.
2. Floored premium: the higher of the rate premium and the lowest premium per stay.
3. Discounted premium (Superhost on the check-in date only): the floored premium multiplied by 100 less the discount percentage, divided by 100.
4. Charged premium: the result rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical rate 2.00 percent, lowest premium 6.00, Superhost discount 25 percent; not a published level)

| Premium base | Rate premium | After the lowest premium | Host is Superhost on check-in date | Charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 900.00 | 18.00 | 18.00 | No | 18.00 |
| 900.00 | 18.00 | 18.00 | Yes | 13.50 |
| 200.00 | 4.00 | 6.00 | No | 6.00 |
| 200.00 | 4.00 | 6.00 | Yes | 4.50 |
| 333.33 | 6.6666 | 6.6666 | Yes | 5.00 (4.99995 rounded half up) |

The fourth row shows the minimum taken first: 4.00 is raised to 6.00, and the discount then acts on 6.00.

## Premium refund (hypothetical)

A stay with a premium base of 900.00 was charged a premium of 18.00. Host-funded refunds later reduce its premium base by 300.00, one third of the base, so one third of the premium, 6.00, is refunded. However large the reduction, the total refunded on the stay never exceeds the 18.00 charged.
